subject: general
question: In 11th century, the army of which of the following Cholas reached upto Ganga to invade Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Rajendra I**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajaraja I:-**

 
 
• He was the first great Chola king who expanded the Chola Empire to include most of South India and parts of Sri Lanka. 
 
• Rajendra I was one of the greatest Chola kings who ruled from 1012 to 1044 CE. 
 
• Rajendra I was known for his military conquests and he invaded many parts of South India, Sri Lanka, and Southeast Asia.
 
• **In the 11th century, the army of Rajendra I reached up to Ganga to invade Bengal.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vijayalaya:-**

 
 
• He was the founder of the Chola dynasty and he conquered Thanjavur from the Muttaraiyar dynasty and established the Chola Empire.
 
 
 
• **Rajadhiraj I:-**
 
 
• He was the son of Rajendra I and he ruled the Chola Empire after his father's death.
